title: 元数据列表列改为在 spec 里声明，经 /meta/types 下发（像表单布局一样）；第一批补上 hook、flow、job 等类型的关键列
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzufqmKuir7GiTdwGd3Z

③ maintainer direct order · Source: maintainer (os-support-ai), 2026-11-24, bug-discussion thread.
- 04:45Z 「现在元数据统一的列表页和详情页的规则是什么？」 → 04:47Z 「深度调研所有的元数据类型，给我一个清单」 (inventory doc: https://claude.ai/artifact/JHVxMK5jTbydtDKi9dVTGg).
- 05:10Z 「既然可以申明表单布局，那是不是也可以申明列表字段？」 (form layouts are declared in spec, so list columns should be declarable too).
- 05:11Z 「立 p1 卡派发」.

Grading: `area:ux · Feature · Studio "All metadata" lists show only name / Label / Description for 22 of 32 types, hiding what a reader scans for (which object a hook binds, when it fires) · builders, often · evidence: read from code`. **priority:p1 set by the maintainer by hand** (05:11Z quote above; see the Ruling-ref comment). Area `ux` by the boundary rule (the lists work; they are hard to use).

Dedupe: `gh api search/issues` on `metadata list columns`, `listColumns metadata type`, `metadata list registry spec`, `studio metadata list default columns` (closed included). Nearest: #20299 (closed: show authored label/description on flows, hooks …), #25909 (closed: Positions list Description column). No open card on declaring list columns.

Reader: seat objectstack#3 (area:ux), one dev card, `domain:spec` + console. Paths on main 14f4d8f8.

## Today

- **Form layouts are declared in spec and served**: `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-registry.ts` (`METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY`, 17 types, from each type's `*.form.ts`) → `TYPE_TO_FORM` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-type-schema.ts` → served as `form` on each `/meta/types` entry (`protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts` ~line 653), beside `schema`, `createSeed` and `actions`. Labels go through the i18n extractor (`packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`, `scripts/i18n-bundle-surface.mjs`, `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts`).
- **List columns are not declared anywhere in spec.** The generic list (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.tsx`, `config.listColumns ?? defaultColumns()` ~line 718) reads a hand-written console registry. Only 9 types register `listColumns` (`services/builtinComponents.tsx`: object, field, view, page, dashboard, book, permission, position; `views/metadata-admin/anchors.ts`: object again with different columns, sharing_rule); `datasource` has its own ListPage. The other **22 types fall back to name / Label / Description** (`defaultColumns`, ~line 1410), with English header labels (`'Label'`, `'Description'`, the raw primary key).
- `object` registers `listColumns` twice with different sets (builtinComponents: name/label/description; anchors.ts: name/label/pluralLabel/fields/description); which one shows depends on registration order (merge, later wins). Not verified which.

## Change

1. **Spec: declare list columns per metadata type**, as a sibling of the form registry (e.g. a list registry keyed by type, or a list section on each type's form declaration; dev's choice, name it in the PR). A column names a top-level key of the type's schema (or a dotted path into it), an i18n-extractable label, and optionally a display hint (badge / count of an array / date). It must be checked against the type's Zod schema (a column naming an undeclared key fails a gate, like the form reconciliation does).
2. **Serve it** on each `/meta/types` entry next to `form` (`protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts`), so Studio, CLI and AI read one declaration.
3. **Console: the generic list reads the served columns.** Precedence: served declaration, then the console `listColumns` only for computed/console-only columns (position's `_holderCount`, `_grantedPermissionSets`; sharing_rule's `_packageId`), then the default. Move the 9 existing console declarations into spec where they name schema keys; resolve the `object` double registration to one set. Header labels come from the declared, translated labels (no raw `'Label'` / `'Description'` / key names in a zh-CN UI).
4. **i18n**: the new labels flow through the same extractor and bundles as form labels; zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES filled (no en echo).
5. **First batch of declared columns** (from the inventory's gap list; dev confirms each key against the type's schema, and drops a column whose key does not exist):

| Type | Columns to declare (beyond name / label) |
| --- | --- |
| `hook` | object, events, priority, async |
| `flow` | type, status / defaultActive |
| `action` | type, the object it belongs to |
| `report` | type, dataset |
| `job` | schedule, enabled |
| `api` | method, path, operation / object |
| `queue` | members (count) |
| `assignment_rule` | object, target |
| `email_template` | locale, subject, category, active |
| `translation` | locale |
| `agent` | model, role |
| `tool` | objectName |
| `skill` | tools (count), active |
| `seed` | object, mode |
| `mapping` | object / target object, direction |
| `picklist` | values (count) |
| `dataset` | source object |
| `doc` | category |

`Metadata-protocol:` expected `none` (a platform registry like the form registry, not author-writable metadata); `/meta/types` gains a served field. Seat confirms the level at dispatch. Changeset for `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and the console package(s).

## Acceptance

- Studio → All metadata → Hooks shows each hook's object and events; Flows shows type; Jobs shows schedule; each first-batch type shows its declared columns; zh-CN headers are Chinese.
- The 9 types that had console columns show the same or better columns; `object` shows one consistent set.
- A plugin-registered type with a declared list gets its columns with no console change; a type with no declaration still gets the default three.
- A declaration naming a key the schema does not have fails a gate.
- `/meta/types` serves the columns; screenshots (zh) of Hooks, Flows and Jobs lists in the PR body.
